proposition: Pick a problem. Leave with something useful.

campaigns.title: Stop losing context
campaigns.participant_job: Produce a portable task-handoff JSON record
campaigns.independent_success: First-time user copies packet to a second unrelated editor and accurately recovers objective, completed step, next action and constraint without extra prompting
campaigns.source_of_truth: Browser-local JSON generated by user request; no delivery/receiver proof
campaigns.growth_path: Voluntary handoff templates, FOSS adapters, explicit receiver readproof
campaigns.critical_counterexample: An AI or human can't understand the packet or loses a constraint
campaigns.effect_gates: No account connection, private task relay or automated tool control

campaigns.title: Proof or promise?
campaigns.participant_job: Classify three assertions about source publication, deployment and a volunteer usability report
campaigns.independent_success: Reader can distinguish public source, deploy success, external browser proof and observed human benefit using their own words
campaigns.source_of_truth: Local quiz explanations grounded in source/receiver distinctions
campaigns.growth_path: Reusable public claim-check modules and criticism receipts
campaigns.critical_counterexample: The quiz rewards agreement without understanding or obscures evidence
campaigns.effect_gates: No covert assessment, tracking or inferred intelligence score

campaigns.title: Make the absurdity visible
campaigns.participant_job: Create and optionally copy one clearly labeled fictional software advertisement
campaigns.independent_success: A first-time reader identifies the material as fiction and recognizes its generic software problem
campaigns.source_of_truth: Fictional sketches, not claims of company endorsements or product readiness
campaigns.growth_path: Opt-in memes, comics, captions, audio and translated remixes retaining source and disclosure
campaigns.critical_counterexample: Reader believes parody is real news, actual job advertisement, product offer or political message
campaigns.effect_gates: No impersonation, false endorsements, automatic posting or unsolicited bulk distribution

campaigns.title: Does the interface accommodate you?
campaigns.participant_job: Change font size and contrast; independently try navigation by keyboard and zoom
campaigns.independent_success: User can locate, activate and return from core activities on their actual device and reports blockers voluntarily
campaigns.source_of_truth: In-page CSS toggles plus W3C WAI preliminary guidance
campaigns.growth_path: Accessible UI improvements shared under relevant open-source licenses and source receipts
campaigns.critical_counterexample: Keyboard controls trap focus, contrast decreases readability, zoom breaks layout or reader can't access content
campaigns.effect_gates: No disability profiling, health data collection, or unsupported WCAG compliance claim

campaigns.title: Official sources first
campaigns.participant_job: Independently follow a federal directory to the responsible state or local election office
campaigns.independent_success: Reader accesses the correct official authority for a jurisdiction-specific voting rule, with no political preference collection
campaigns.source_of_truth: Vote.gov, USAGov and state/local election office information
campaigns.growth_path: Neutral source-finding and accessibility improvements only; no electoral persuasion
campaigns.critical_counterexample: Broken links, misleading jurisdictional rules, confusing source authority or inaccessible election information
campaigns.effect_gates: No party/candidate promotion, persuasion optimization, voter targeting, personal political profiles or fake official notice

campaigns.title: Wonder, then test
campaigns.participant_job: Draft a personal observation/inspiration, hypothesis and possible counterexample
campaigns.independent_success: Reader distinguishes inspiration from observation and proposes a check that could challenge an explanation
campaigns.growth_path: Independent artistic interpretations and opt-in documented experiments, retaining uncertainty
campaigns.critical_counterexample: Speculative or dream-inspired content is mistaken for physical proof, mind-reading, divine endorsement, ET claim or guaranteed capability
campaigns.effect_gates: No covert sensing, private memory access, induced mental states, medical or metaphysical truth claims

core_cycle: Let the participant freely opt out
strategy.growth_claim: Unproven. Possible local compound effects do not imply universal exponential reach, audience adoption, funding or trust.
strategy.investments: Prioritize usability, evidence quality, permissioned distribution, accessible formats, maintenance and honest correction before buying impressions.
strategy.art_scope: CoArt/CoAwe may invite curiosity; no psychological manipulation, covert profiling or supernatural proof claims.
strategy.audience_design: Self-selecting and user-directed; no covert inference of traits or voting preferences.
strategy.egress: No automatic network posts, emails, bulk messages, paid media or credential use.
strategy.failure_economics: Stop a misleading/dangerous release even when it appears to drive clicks. Treat explicit opt-outs as success of participant autonomy.
strategy.negative_space: Permit campaigns, surfaces and translations that are intentionally not active when they add little value or lack evidence.

technical_scope.on_page_interaction: Browser-local script; no external script import or automatic outgoing network request in source.
technical_scope.storage: Nothing is intentionally persisted. Typed content is held in tab memory and cleared on reload. Clipboard writes require an explicit click and host permission.
technical_scope.collection: No campaign telemetry, survey, user identification or political data collection.
technical_scope.independent_validation: Outstanding: actual browser rendering, outside network GET, genuine participating readers and learning outcomes.

governance.privacy: Privacy by default, no data send without voluntary explicit action
governance.safety: No social bot swarms, fake social proof, political persuasion, or automated enrollment
governance.truth: Separate imagination, source existence, deployment, independent receiver proof, and human benefit
governance.participation: Voluntary, accessible, respectful, reversible where possible
governance.stewardship: Contribution does not imply automatic permission, endorsement, co-ownership or affiliation
governance.provenance: Each public campaign links to exact source plus machine-readable candidacy status
